speaker: Mr Leon Perera
text: asked the Minister for Home Affairs (a) what is the progress of Traffic Police’s planning on the initiative to require speed-management devices on lorries that are used to ferry migrant workers; and (b) what is the expected timeline for the adoption of such devices on all such lorries.

speaker: Mr Leon Perera (Aljunied)
text: I hope that it would be a short timeline, given that we have worked on it for quite some time now.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: As I shared earlier, we have been actively engaging the industry.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: As you can see, it is a wide range of fleets of lorries, from the older ones to the newer ones.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: We are grateful that the industry players have come forward to share with us frankly and they also shared with us some of the supply chain constraints that the world is facing today.
